messages:
maria (sec-eng): FYI - our KMS alert flagged ~1,200 decrypt ops from service-account/searcher-svc between 02:14-02:22 UTC. page me if you're on-call. looks like an RBAC rollback change from earlier may have granted elevated role.
incident-bot: Alert: KMS_DECRYPT_ANOMALY id=kmx-9832 triggered at 2026-03-14T02:15:07Z
li (eng-oncall): I'm looking. Can someone confirm what change rolled back RBAC? any PR/terraform apply?
tom (infra): I rolled back a policy earlier to debug a deploy, didn't think it touched service accounts. checking terraform history now.
maria (sec-eng): Action items: 1) temp disable searcher-svc 2) revoke elevated role from SA 3) rotate KMS key if decrypts were unauthorized 4) export audit logs (retain) 5) draft comms for exec + customers.
li (eng-oncall): Running commands now:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts disable searcher-svc@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
gcloud kms keys versions destroy --location=global --keyring=prod-kr --key=searcher-key --version=1
```
(li: using snippets for ops checklist)
sam (customer-success): Any indicators of customer data exposure? we need to know before outreach.
maria (sec-eng): No confirmed exfil. decrypt ops look internal (same IP ranges) but unauthorized. we've exported audit logs and started token revocation. recommend we treat as potential exposure until proven otherwise.
jenna (legal): Keep communications short and non-accusatory. Exec update should be internal-only for now. If customer-facing, use 'investigating' language and mitigation steps. I'll draft language.
li (eng-oncall): Confirmed an admin role was added at 2026-03-14T01:58:02Z by terraform apply id=tx-772. Marking change as root cause candidate.
tom (infra): That was my rollback. I'm rolling back to the pre-change state and rotating the service account key. Also disabling any tokens issued since 01:58.
maria (sec-eng): Good. Jenna, draft please. Also prepare an internal advisory for all eng teams: review terraform applies this week and pause non-urgent rollbacks.
jenna (legal): Draft exec update (internal): "We're investigating unauthorized KMS decrypt activity linked to a service account after an RBAC change. We have contained the activity by disabling the SA, revoking roles, exporting logs, and rotating keys. No confirmed customer data exposure; investigation ongoing. We will update within 4 hours." Feedback?
sam (customer-success): That reads fine. For customers: we should offer specifics only if confirmed. Proposed customer line: "We detected anomalous activity related to internal key usage; we've taken containment actions and are investigating. We will follow up with details if customer data is impacted"
maria (sec-eng): Agree. Also need short timeline for postmortem and actions: rotate all affected keys, add Terraform policy guard to disallow direct role grants to prod SAs, add audit alert for sudden decrypt rate spikes, and quarterly RBAC review.
li (eng-oncall): Logged incident as SEV2 1776501234 in incident tracker, assigned to sec-eng+infra. Scheduling post-incident review tomorrow 15:00 UTC.
tom (infra): Notes: will add a pre-apply checklist and require at least one review for IAM changes.
maria (sec-eng): Thanks. I'll prepare the internal advisory and attach the audit export. tagging @exec-leads for visibility :eyes: 
incident-bot: Incident 1776501234 created; severity=SEV2; status=investigating
